description: This file defines an Android activity 'RoundRects' that demonstrates drawing multiple styled gradient drawables with rounded corners and different gradient types on a Canvas within a custom View.

classes.name: RoundRects
classes.description: Main activity class that initializes and displays a custom view demonstrating gradient drawables with rounded corners.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: Inner class extending View that handles drawing multiple gradient drawables with different gradient types and corner radii.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Activity lifecycle method that sets up the content view.

methods.name: SampleView
methods.description: Constructor that initializes drawing objects and the gradient drawable.

methods.name: setCornerRadii
methods.description: Static helper method to set different corner radii on a GradientDrawable.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overrides View's onDraw to render multiple styled gradient drawables on the canvas.
